Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal

Class CanonicalBlocks

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.CanonicalBlocks
public final class CanonicalBlocks extends Object
Dense, version independent block state indices ("canonical" ids). Every state of the newest bundled version gets one, in that version's vanilla palette order, so they are stable for a Paletter release. Custom blocks of layers are appended, in layer order, per lineage of layers: the same layer stack gives the same indices in every version.

Not API: consumers hold BedrockBlockState handles and never see these ids; the handles carry them in a hidden field and Palette#runtimeId(BedrockBlockState) is an array lookup with them.

Since:
1.0.0

    • forward

      public @NonNull Forwarding forward(@NonNull org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap state)
      Maps a state of any bundled version to the canonical ids, which the newest version defines:
      1. a state the newest version has (or a custom state of this lineage) is Forwarding.Kind.EXACT;
      2. a block Bedrock renamed is looked up under its new identifier (Forwarding.Kind.RENAMED);
      3. a block with other state keys or values is adapted like an older palette adapts newer states, the other way round: values the newest block still has are carried over, keys it added get the default, removed keys are dropped (Forwarding.Kind.ADAPTED);
      4. otherwise Forwarding.Kind.UNKNOWN with the reason, and no canonical id.
      Block fallbacks are not involved: they go from the newest version to an older one, this goes the other way.
      Since:
      1.0.0
